architecture.state_space: 60 estados (10 Regímenes S0..S9 × 3 Arquetipos × 2 Estados Guardián)
architecture.retraining_schedule: Domingos 22:00 UTC + Gatillo Intra-Semanal por Deriva (Drift Trigger)

0.label: Tendencia Alcista Fuerte Limpia
0.description: ADX >= 25, +DI > -DI, Close >= EMA50 > EMA200, H_norm <= 0.78, Kurt_rob <= 3.20

2.label: Clímax / Sobreextensión Alcista
2.description: +DI > -DI, Close > EMA50, pero ATR_Ratio > 1.50 o Kurt_rob > 3.20

3.label: Tendencia Bajista Ordenada
3.description: ADX >= 25, -DI > +DI, Close <= EMA50 < EMA200, H_norm <= 0.78, Kurt_rob <= 3.20

5.label: Capitulación / Pánico Bajista
5.description: -DI > +DI, Close < EMA50, ATR_Ratio > 1.50 (cascada con rebote en V)

8.label: Rango Sucio / Colas Pesadas
8.description: ADX < 21, Kurt_rob > 3.20 o 1.25 < ATR_Ratio <= 1.60 (zona de whipsaws)

9.label: Caos / Ruido Blanco (Blackout)
9.description: H_norm > 0.84 o Delta_H > 0.12 o ATR_Ratio > 2.20 -> Bloqueo 0.00x

PROP_FIRM.algorithm: Tabular Double Q-Learning + Dual-Memory (80/20) + Polyak Soft-Update

CAPITAL_PROPIO.algorithm: Tabular Double Q-Learning + Dual-Memory (80/20) + Polyak Soft-Update
